policy: A host may support MANUFACTURER_VERIFIED only when status is ESTABLISHED: the host is the official asset/product host of the brand's current owner, and that link is recorded here with evidence. NOT_ESTABLISHED and NOT_MANUFACTURER hosts cannot support MANUFACTURER_VERIFIED; their values are demoted to CITED_IN_NOTES_UNCHECKED with history. BRAND_DOMAIN_UNVERIFIED hosts keep their existing claims but are flagged for review; they are not counted as verified ownership.
